description: Observed-order-of-accuracy sweep for grids/cartesian_uniform_1d/rules/hjweno_norm_D1_periodic driven by problems/hjweno_norm_1d_eikonal_mms.esm, loaded once per resolution with the loader-API metaparameter binding (esm-spec 9.7.6 binding site 4). Forced-steady eikonal u_t = -S*hjweno(u) + S|g'| with exact solution g = sin(2 pi x); the discretization error is the fifth-order Hamilton-Jacobi WENO-Z truncation S*(|g'| - hjweno(g)) = O(dx^5). g is smooth so the WENO-Z one-sided derivative reconstructions stay fifth order even at the critical points u_x = 0 (x = 1/4, 3/4), and the Godunov entropy fix resolves the |grad| kinks; both L2 and Linf fall as O(dx^5) (expected order 5). Julia integrator tolerances pinned tight (reltol 1e-12, abstol 1e-14) so Tsit5 temporal truncation stays well below the finest spatial error (~2e-9 at N=128), isolating the spatial order.

scope_excluded.go: rewrite-only port; no makearray lowering / simulator
